items.title: Dominion Energy (D) Draws Fresh ETF Inflows, Is The Recovery Already Priced In?
items.summary: Fresh ETF flows have put Dominion Energy (D) back in focus after funds added a net US$123.0 million on November 17, extending a three day streak of institutional buying. items.title: Why Is Dominion Energy (D) Facing Tough Questions In Virginia Merger Hearings?
items.summary: Dominion Energy (NYSE:D) is facing formal Virginia State Corporation Commission hearings on its proposed merger with NextEra Energy. items.title: DOJ closes antitrust probe into NextEra’s $66.8 bln Dominion deal
items.summary: Investing.com-- The U.S. Department of Justice said on Thursday it had closed its antitrust investigation into Nextera Energy's (NYSE:NEE) $66.8 billion acquisition of Dominion Energy (NYSE:D) after the companies committed to safeguards addressing concerns over electricity prices in New England.
